notes.title: Dev Log Update
notes.notes:
Currently about 1 month away from the demo hitting the page!

At the moment I am adding the options page and about half way done. I want to give the players enough options, within reason, to be able to play the game on a variety of hardware.

MOTION BLUR WILL BE OFF BY DEFAULT BECAUSE EVERYBODY HATES IT!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566255/65d3964ace319507128969a9ca8bd073840ba155.gif

Including:

Resolution
Brightness
Anti-Aliasing
Texture Quality
Shadow Quality
SFX Volume
Ambience Volume
Music Volume
Head Bob
Motion Blur
Color Vision Deficiency
HUD Size
Language
Look Sensitivity
Invert Axis
VSYNC
Frame Rate


If YOU see something missing that you believe is important please contact me!
